flags.observation: Style B's bright bouncing ska risks undercutting the respect promised in beat 2 for a deck touching real deaths.
Stand-up setup runs 184 characters in one beat; the punch "of little practical significance" arrives late and lands clumsily.
"ten veils" and "Treasury" each spoken twice in one line; the cut repeats the name and no claim is added.
"little own money" is ungrammatical and hard to say; the leverage point reads garbled.
"demanding two separate events to win" drops that the attacks were to be counted as two events; meaning shifts.
Line recites the power, "initial equity refunded while maintaining total control"; the card's payback deal and profit claim are missing.
Colon chain "Silver Stream E-Link, Marsh:" and "this paperless technology" with no referent make the line stumble.
Opens with "But" like beat 20, only six lines apart; same opener family under the ten-line distance.
Only beats 14 and 30 use artwork images ("VOID receipts", "empty chairs"); KayfabeTip 5 is otherwise absent across the track.
Double colon chain "About the surge: The Absolute Shopping Binge:"; "dripping with irony" floats without its speaker; 105 characters.
105 characters with opener; beats 20, 22, 23 and 30 also run 103, beyond the 80 to 95 one-breath range.
"foreign finance ministers certain;" leaves the certainty without an object; the listener cannot close the thought.
Beats 24 to 29 run six cards with no opener or bridge; the therefore/but chain stops for the whole stretch.
"no ties" truncated to a stub; closure lost, and the phrase returns in beat 29.
"WHO" in capitals risks being voiced as the acronym, breaking the question.
Power dominates: "ninety-five percent of puts" and "free pass"; who dismissed the trades disappears from the line.
